## Summary

I extracted **10 program graphs** from the Compound Whitepaper (v1.0, February 2019) by Robert Leshner and Geoffrey Hayes. The whitepaper describes a decentralized money market protocol on Ethereum. Here is a breakdown of each subgraph:

| ID | Name | Description | Key Invariants |
|:---|:-----|:------------|:---------------|
| SG-001 | **mint** | Supply underlying assets, receive cTokens | Exchange rate monotonically increasing; transfer-before-mint |
| SG-002 | **redeem** | Burn cTokens, withdraw underlying assets | Must not violate borrowing capacity; requires sufficient cash |
| SG-003 | **borrow** | Borrow underlying using cTokens as collateral | Borrowed value must never exceed borrowing capacity |
| SG-004 | **repayBorrow** | Repay outstanding loan (self or on behalf) | Repay must not exceed current balance; totalBorrows decreases exactly |
| SG-005 | **liquidate** | Liquidate underwater borrower, seize collateral | Only when shortfall > 0; close factor limits partial liquidation |
| SG-006 | **accrueInterest** | Per-block interest accrual on borrow index | Index monotonically increasing; reserves grow by reserveFactor |
| SG-007 | **exchangeRate** | Compute cToken-to-underlying exchange rate | `(cash + totalBorrows - reserves) / cTokenSupply`; monotonically increasing |
| SG-008 | **getAccountLiquidity** | Comptroller collateral/borrow check | Sum of weighted collateral vs sum of borrows; oracle price must be valid |
| SG-009 | **interestRateModel** | Linear interest rate model based on utilization | `borrowRate = baseRate + U * multiplier`; supply rate is implicit |
| SG-010 | **supportMarket** | Admin whitelisting of new cToken markets | Requires valid oracle price; initial collateralFactor = 0 |

All `.mmd` files are located under `/Users/hiro/Documents/security-agent/outputs/graphs/batch_w2b2_1773060675/compound-whitepaper/`.
